In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], a [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruiser]] loyal to [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] attacked the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' at the [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] [[Tanquilla Beach/Legends|''Tanquilla Beach'']]. The light cruiser was destroyed by the combined forces of the ''FarStar'' and ''Tanquilla Beach''.
